name: Maritana Minerals Limited
summary: Maritana Minerals Limited is an Australian company dedicated to the discovery, advancement, and extraction of gold and various other mineral resources. Its primary focus lies in identifying deposits of gold, nickel, cobalt, silver, and zinc. The company, which was established in 1974 and is headquartered in West Perth, Australia, previously operated under the name Horizon Minerals Limited before adopting Maritana Minerals Limited in April 2026.
